<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Voter roll revision:</strong> Following a Supreme Court directive, the Election Commission of India has extended the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) timelines for voter rolls in Maharashtra, Delhi, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Haryana, and Nagaland.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxOMDM0T3doYjd0bDFtSzFzOWtwRmoxNjdjSHpyVXRyWnNuUnV6R1dKVXd5bndHNHR0U1NNUmNIemEtbjhfX3psQ3FaTHlmMkdpYWxOY0tkdURZMmNPTGxTSWlFQVc1dmdxR1RocVBYaFR5MGp4cDNsVFRZVXRBYklRTEFSN082V2N0eUp5cWJ4ckw3TDJjTEE0b09EMU9SeGFqRkNnX0RCSXN0Y1p6Q3RzQjBsaw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial rebuke:</strong> The Supreme Court has sharply criticized the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, alleging that the administration of the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) has been &quot;completely hijacked&quot; by the government.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election results:</strong> In recent legislative council (MLC) elections, the BJP secured six seats while the Samajwadi Party won five in Uttar Pradesh, prompting the BJP to emphasize that ballot results remain the ultimate test of political support.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxOTXo4b0lrWWpJUUk3c0FYMmhQU0sxcFplWTZMRUluZDVodThDNVVCT3lzOXBsUC1mSjBLX05pa2hocko3ZVY2RTNDeGRmLURVdEplRTFRd0hWdXdyV0d2RzBDeFlielFnQUdaVDU1OEh2azZaYVZuZE8yQnhaSnVXRlJLT3NkeUc5XzFlRVM3RDdUdw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Energy policy:</strong> The Tamil Nadu government has introduced a new policy offering a 100% charge waiver for battery energy storage systems to boost the state&#x27;s renewable energy infrastructure.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
</ul>
